contentPattern: cmp-teaser--hero-home: desktop+mobile video (TIB-Reel-Home-tardor-2026-Master / -mobile), text 'It's mushroom season. / Or autumn, as some people call it.' | Full-screen video hero (approved mapping cmp-teaser--hero-home -> hero-video). Desktop and mobile Scene7 videos in media rows, the two text lines as paragraphs.

cells: Paragraph 'It's mushroom season.' + paragraph 'Or autumn, as some people call it.'

blockContent.notes: Base hero is media row + content row; the variant adds a second media row for the mobile source. No heading: the lines are paragraphs.

usage: Full-screen home hero: desktop Scene7 video (row 1), mobile Scene7 video (row 2), and text paragraphs (row 3). Videos autoplay muted, loop and play inline; the poster image in each media row shows until the video plays. The block swaps to the mobile video below 900px.
reuseGuidance: Use for a full-bleed video hero with no heading. For an image or single-video banner with a title and CTA, use hero-banner.
